tools.name: search
tools.description: Search published THE COOP articles, approved glossary terms, provider and media profiles and industry events by meaning and keywords. Use for questions and discovery; use search_providers for a name/category directory browse. Returns relevance-ranked results, one passage per record with slug, canoni

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get one published article by exact slug, including full text, sources, author, dates and any sponsorship disclosure. Discover its slug with search or list_articles first. Unknown or unpublished slugs return a not-found error; use search for discovery, list_articles for recent summaries.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List published article summaries, newest publication first, optionally filtered by topic and format. Returns page, total_items, total_pages and items with slugs, canonical URLs, excerpts and dates. Defaults to page 1 with 10 records; use search for a question or keywords, then get_article for full t

tools.name: search_payment_capabilities
tools.description: Find reviewed public payment product scopes using country, region, currency, flow, method and integration filters. Filters must match the same scope. Confirmed and currency_leads are separately paginated with the same page and limit; each has total_items, total_pages and items. A currency lead has u

tools.name: get_payment_capabilities
tools.description: Get all reviewed public product scopes for a provider in a payment category by exact slug, with supporting facts, sources and checked dates. An empty list means no mapped evidence, not absence of a capability. Profiles outside payment categories are not found.

tools.name: compare_payment_capabilities
tools.description: Read reviewed public payment product scopes for two to four payment-category provider slugs side by side, with their evidence, sources and unknowns. Optional filters label each full scope confirmed, country-unknown or not-matched using the same rules as search. Does not rank providers or establish e

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Browse published provider and media profiles by name, category and review status. Results are paginated, desk-reviewed first and then alphabetical. Use get_provider for sourced facts; media profiles are not rated as providers.

tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Deprecated alias of search_providers. Browse published provider and media profiles by name, category and review status. Results are paginated, desk-reviewed first and then alphabetical. Use get_provider for sourced facts; media profiles are not rated as providers.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Get a published provider or media profile by exact slug, including sourced facts and evidence statuses, approved answers and overview, sources, assessment and missing information. Supplier-stated means the organisation says so, not independent verification. Missing means unknown; egg_score measures

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Deprecated alias of get_provider. Get a published provider or media profile by exact slug, including sourced facts and evidence statuses, approved answers and overview, sources, assessment and missing information. Supplier-stated means the organisation says so, not independent verification. Missing

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List published iGaming event summaries with slugs, canonical URLs, dates, venue and exhibitor counts. Filter by period, region and text together. Defaults to upcoming (including ongoing), page 1, 10 records; upcoming/all sort by start date ascending, past descending. Returns page, total_items, total

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get one published event by exact slug from list_events or search, with dates, venue, organiser sources and exhibitor count. Unknown or unpublished slugs return a not-found error. By default the large exhibitor list is omitted; use list_exhibitors to filter and page booths, or include_exhibitors=true

tools.name: list_exhibitors
tools.description: List an event's published exhibitor booths, with provider profile links when available. Use an event_slug from list_events; get_event gives event details. Category and text filters combine with AND. Returns event, page, total_items, total_pages and items; defaults to page 1 with 20 booths in publish

tools.name: explain_term
tools.description: Get a complete approved glossary entry by exact term, alias, ID or slug, with sources and revision. An ambiguous or unavailable term returns not found. Definitions are educational, not evidence of any company’s capabilities.

tools.name: about_the_coop
tools.description: Get publication information, indexed coverage counts and freshness, citation and evidence guidance, and what this server logs. Call with no arguments for questions about THE COOP or interpreting its records; use search to find published content.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Semantic + keyword search across published THE COOP articles, supplier and media profiles and industry events. Returns one passage per record with canonical URLs, dates and a text-relevance band, not an answer-confidence score. Use get_article / get_supplier / get_event for the full record." → after: "Search published THE COOP articles, approved glossary terms, provider and media profiles and industry events by meaning and keywords. Use for questions and discovery; use search_providers for a name/category directory browse. Returns relevance-ranked results, one passage per record with slug, canoni"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
